items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Before you mention Blar and Gilbert, did you know him well?

ctx.x: No, I never heard him play piano. He might have picked it up maybe when he got married, eh? I tell you one thing, though, that fellow, you see him? All the way he came on, that's just natural. They know put no, they know nothing to add on to his life. That's just natural. And that's the way he always was, from a kid. I know him from a kid. Always joking, killing, and laughing, make all kinds of spaces and everything. That's natural. That ain't nothing, no, no put on, no special gestures. Nothing, that's just…
Before you mention Blar and Gilbert, did you know him well?
Well, I know him from playing because him and my brother was pretty good friends. And you know Gilbert could play piano too, you know that? Yeah.
